leads.name: Carvalho de Calvos
leads.species_basis: genus read from the tree's own name; ask the reader which species
leads.note: Verified 2026-09-27 to data/research/famousportugal-verified.json as clv_001, "The Carvalho de Calvos". Povoa de Lanhoso, Braga district (not Ponte da Barca). Quercus robur, classified arvore de interesse publico since 22 August 1997, age (500+ years) scientifically dated in 2011 by the University of Coimbra. Stands inside its own dedicated Centro de Interpretacao. Strong single-tree destination candidate; far from any published place.

leads.species_basis: genus read from the tree's own name; ask the reader which species
leads.note: Verified 2026-09-27 to data/research/famousportugal-verified.json as run_001, "The Cedro de Runa". Cupressus lusitanica, planted early 1950s by a named local resident, confirmed by three sources including the official contest page. Won national "Arvore do Ano Portugal 2026" in January 2026, a strong and very recent fame signal. Coordinate confirmed three ways.
